subject.title: [BUG]: Browser tool: `snapshot` returns page content before scroll, ignoring viewport position

question: Should browser snapshots become viewport-scoped after scroll, or should OpenClaw keep full-tree snapshots and add explicit viewport/scroll metadata or a separate viewport mode?
rationale: Current docs and dependencies expose tree snapshots, while the reported workflow needs visible-viewport semantics; changing the default could improve automation below the fold but may break agents that depend on full-page refs.

options.title: Add viewport-aware contract
options.body: Implement visible-viewport snapshot behavior or an explicit viewport mode, include scroll/viewport metadata, and keep full-tree access available for global ref discovery.

options.title: Keep full-tree default
options.body: Document the current full-tree behavior and add guidance to use screenshots or targeted selectors for viewport verification.

options.title: Fold into broad browser snapshot redesign
options.body: Track this under the broader browser snapshot/context-budget work and leave this issue open as scroll-specific evidence.

recommendation.title: Add viewport-aware contract
recommendation.body: Implement visible-viewport snapshot behavior or an explicit viewport mode, include scroll/viewport metadata, and keep full-tree access available for global ref discovery.

likelyOwner.reason: Most central history on the browser snapshot ownership and CDP fallback paths points to steipete.
